claims.text: Retrieved the official Node.js Release Working Group schedule and its machine-readable schedule.json. The release page links to this upstream schedule. Dates are subject to change; the following assessment uses 2026-10-17 as its reference date.

evidence.locator: v22, v24 and v26 entries, lines 121-150

claims.text: Node.js 24 (Krypton): Active LTS starts 2025-10-28, Maintenance LTS starts 2026-10-20, and end of life is scheduled for 2028-04-30. Thus it is Active LTS on 2026-10-17.
Node.js 26 is scheduled to enter Active LTS on 2026-10-28. On 2026-10-17 it is Current, not yet LTS; the retrieved official status tables also label it Current.
Node.js 22 (Jod) is supported in Maintenance LTS on 2026-10-17: maintenance started 2025-10-21 and EOL is scheduled for 2027-04-30. Maintenance covers critical bug fixes and security updates.

evidence.locator: Release schedule line 4; Release Phases lines 23-25 and 30-31

claims.text: Recommendation based on the dated schedule: choose Node.js 24 rather than 26 for a deployment requiring LTS on 2026-10-17, conditional on application compatibility and verification of the deployed patch. The official production guidance calls for Active LTS or Maintenance LTS; 24 qualifies on that date and 26 does not yet qualify.

The schedule describes release-line support phases and planned dates, not the exact patch installed in a deployment. The policy describes eligible updates, including critical bug fixes and security updates during maintenance. Research limitation: no runtime, installed patch, artifact provenance, deployment update process or security-advisory coverage was inspected; therefore this note does not verify patch currency or guarantee that a deployment is vulnerability-free. Those require separate verification of the actual deployed artifact and relevant advisories. Scheduled dates may change.

evidence.locator: Date caveat line 7; Release Phases lines 18-28
v24 entry, lines 133-139 (major-line dates, no installed artifact information)

recommendation: For LTS required now on 2026-10-17, select Node.js 24, subject to application compatibility and separate deployed-patch/security verification. Its scheduled Maintenance LTS transition on 2026-10-20 remains an LTS phase. Reassess Node.js 26 once its scheduled 2026-10-28 LTS transition is confirmed by an actual release. This is a recommendation derived from the cited schedule and official production guidance, not an installed-version audit.
unknowns: All three primary-source URLs were retrieved successfully with the native web tool; no HTTP failure or unavailable research tool was encountered.

The upstream main-branch URLs are mutable; no historical commit snapshot was retrieved. Dates and displayed statuses agree with the requested 2026-10-17 assessment, but later schedule changes remain possible.
Installed Node.js version, application compatibility, artifact integrity, applicable vulnerabilities and patch completeness remain unverified. No local runtime or other repositories were inspected.
